summary: Iteration 22 — both bugs verified fixed. 7/7 tests pass. BUG1: GET /api/daybook exposes cash+online+total for every section (daily_sales, invoices, due_collection, receipts) — collection online (500), invoice online (2000), standalone receipt online (100) all flow into their section.online and into grand_total.online (delta=2600 verified). Legacy receipts with payment_mode='online' and no cash_amount/online_amount fields still contribute 1500 to receipts.online via daybook's fallback logic. BUG2: PATCH /api/daily-sales/{id} correctly permits admin to modify ANY user's entry (denominations {500:2,100:5} → {500:3,100:5}; cash_total recomputed from 1500 to 2000; user field preserved as 'emp1'). Non-admin emp2 attempting to PATCH emp1's entry → 403. Owner emp1 editing own → 200. Admin DELETE /api/daily-sales/{id} on emp1's entry → 200, subsequent DELETE → 404, entry no longer visible in GET list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1805 correctly implements 'admin OR owner' rule for PATCH /daily-sales — role check comes before user-match check.
server.py:1829 DELETE /daily-sales uses admin_only dependency — admin can delete any daily_sales entry (as required by the bug fix).
server.py:1864-1894 daybook receipts split correctly prefers explicit cash_amount/online_amount and falls back on payment_mode for legacy docs.
server.py:1942-1962 invoice split logic in daybook mirrors the same fallback pattern — legacy invoices treated as all-cash (documented behaviour, retained from iteration 21).

server.py:1965-1994 grand_total avoids double-counting: daily_sales is deliberately excluded so grand_total = collections + invoices + standalone_receipts (source_type='other'). This is by design and confirmed in comments.

All cleaned up by autouse module-scoped teardown fixture (deletes collections, invoices, receipts, daily_sales via API, legacy receipts via direct Mongo, and TEST22-tagged customers via API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22_daybook_online_and_admin_edit.py. Note pytest-xdist loadscope groups tests by class — the two daybook receipts.online tests are intentionally in the same class (TestDaybookOnlineVisibility) so they run serially on one worker; if you split them into separate classes they will race and one will fail intermittently. Cleanup fixture is autouse module-scoped, so no manual cleanup needed. Test credentials are admin/Admin@2026 and emp1/emp2/Emp@2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
rca_of_issue: Both bugs pre-fixed by main agent. BUG1 RCA: earlier iterations aggregated only cash for receipts/invoices/collections; fix adds explicit cash_amount/online_amount fields plus a fallback on payment_mode for legacy docs (server.py:1864-1894 for receipts, 1942-1962 for invoices), and daybook returns {cash, online, total} per section and grand_total. BUG2 RCA: update_daily_sale (server.py:1799-1826) checks `u['role'] != 'admin' and doc['user'] != u['username']` before 403, allowing admin to modify any user's entry; delete_daily_sale (1829-1834) uses admin_only dependency so only admin can delete. Verified end-to-end: admin edits emp1's cash denominations, cash_total recomputes correctly, user field remains 'emp1', DELETE cascades to 404 on re-read.
